findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, House second reading, roll call 758 (passed 66-47); the member's vote is listed as Aye on https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/Votes/H/837
findings.note: Gable voted yes on the House passage of HB 958. Per the General Assembly's bill summaries, the bill as it later stood covers: photo ID for military and overseas ballots and curing a missing ID copy; a citizenship statement required on voter registration applications at the DMV, other agencies and county boards; checks of voter lists for non-citizens; and a statewide audit of ineligible early and absentee ballots. The House version on this date may differ from the later Senate version.
subjects: voter ID for military and overseas ballots

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, House vote to concur in the Senate committee substitute, roll call 801 (passed 62-47); the member's vote is listed as Aye on https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/Votes/H/837
findings.note: Gable voted yes to concur in the Senate version of HB 958. The bill was ratified 2026-08-06 and vetoed by the Governor on 2026-08-17; the bill page shows it placed on the House calendar for 2026-09-02. The final-version summary covers citizenship statements on registration, photo ID rules for overseas ballots, cure of missing ID on cast ballots, voter-list maintenance and an audit of ineligible early and absentee ballots.
